properties.name: jwt.secret
properties.description: Secret key used to sign HS256 JWTs. Overridable via the JWT_SECRET_KEY environment variable.

properties.name: jwt.expiration-ms-user
properties.description: JWT expiry in milliseconds for regular user accounts.

properties.name: jwt.expiration-ms-staff
properties.description: JWT expiry in milliseconds for staff accounts.

properties.name: jwt.expiration-ms-admin
properties.description: JWT expiry in milliseconds for admin accounts.

properties.name: fleet.maintenance.odometer-interval-km
properties.description: Odometer interval in kilometres that triggers a preventive maintenance order.

properties.name: fleet.speeding-threshold-kmh
properties.description: Speed threshold in km/h above which a GPS ping is flagged as speeding.

properties.name: fleet.gps.stale-minutes
properties.description: Age in minutes after which a vehicle's last GPS ping is considered stale, blocking trip start.
